title: Meta announces launch of Instagram for TV in India
summary: Meta announces the launch of Instagram for TV in India
detailed: Meta announced the upcoming launch of Instagram for TV in India during its annual creator event.
The app will be available on supported Apple TV, Fire TV, and Google TV devices within days to facilitate shared viewing of creator content.
The platform applies 13+ content ratings for Reels and includes teen safeguards such as content limitations, comment restrictions, and connection to mobile usage limits and sleep modes.
This matters because it expands Meta's social video ecosystem onto living room screens with localized safety controls for Indian families and teenagers.
sentences: Instagram for TV will soon be available in India.
The announcement was made at the annual creator event by Meta on Friday.
“We announced Instagram for TV brings content from your favorite creators to the big screen in your home so you can enjoy watching them with friends.
We’ve heard from our community that watching creator content together is more fun, and this experience will provide that to people in India,” stated a press note from the company.
The app will be available on supported Apple TV, Fire TV, and Google TV devices in a few days from now.
“Instagram for TV is built for shared viewing, so we apply content standards suitable for a broad audience.
In this test, Reels generally follow the 13+ Content Ratings system we recently introduced on the mobile app.
For teens, Instagram for TV is intended to reflect the same general safeguards available on the Instagram mobile app.
This includes limiting access to content, comments and profiles that may be unsuitable for people under 18.

Time spent on Instagram for TV contributes to a Teen Account’s overall usage limits, and teens may receive the same reminders about approaching or reaching those limits or sleep mode,” the company said.
